US to Drop Charges Against Ex-CIA Analyst in South Korea Case

The U.S. Department of Justice will drop charges against a former CIA analyst accused of aiding South Korean intelligence. The analyst, who was not named in the coverage, had been accused of providing classified information. The decision to drop the charges comes as part of a deal, though the specifics of the deal were not detailed. This move halts the prosecution of the former analyst.
